data.summary: The existing reviews appear authentic and detailed, praising communication, professionalism, and quality. However, the extremely low volume of reviews (7) over 18 years is a significant anomaly and raises questions about the company's online review presence. There is no evidence of fake review patterns in the content itself, but the scarcity of data is a concern.
fake_signals: Low review volume (7) for an 18-year-old company
Clustering of 4 reviews from 4 years ago
authentic_signals: Specific project details (refinishing concrete, retiling, lights, acid wash)
Mention of specific crew names (Hudson, Nick, Jerry)
Varied writing styles and personal anecdotes
Mention of ongoing support ('still answering my questions')
Reference to neighborhood projects ('built 4 more pools in my neighborhood')
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one platform (Google) has a rating, which is perfect. BBB has an A+ rating with no complaints. No contradictory data exists.

reviews.text: I didn’t know what I wanted my pool to look like, I just knew I wanted it and I had a Pinterest board full of inspiration! Not only did Hudson, Nick & Jerry bring that to life, they killed & in record time! Not only are they great to work with, they are great people and that the kind of people I like to do business with. Almost 9 months later they are still answering my questions. I couldn’t be happier with the way it came out and I can’t wait to enjoy my pool this summer!
reviews.author: Karla Kopp

reviews.text: Highly recommend Johnston Custom Pools as Jerry and his team are very easy to work with, professional, knowledgeable, and punctual. They were able to create exactly what we wanted and made sure we were pleased every step of the way. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Baron Hodo

reviews.text:
I highly recommended Johnston Custom Pools. Jerry and his team were were extremely professional. Jerry or someone from his company was present every step in the process, overseeing the project and answering all of our questions. Not only did he build our pool, he built our outdoor kitchen, fire pit and brought in someone to do our outdoor sound system and out door lighting.  Since completing our project he has built 4 more pools in my neighborhood.
Jerry was a pleasure to work with, and love our pool and backyard.
reviews.author: Bandi Johnson

reviews.text: Jerry is extremely professional and great to work with. He is always on time and ensures everything is done correctly and efficiently. Everything from the initial consultation, the design work, change requests, construction, and “pool school” training was perfect. I highly recommend anyone interested in a pool and/or outdoor living space to contact Johnston Custom Pools.
reviews.author: James Chambers
